articles.summary: Sanmina Corporation ("Sanmina" or the "Company") (NASDAQ: SANM), a leading integrated manufacturing solutions company, today reported financial results for the fourth quarter ended October 3, 2026 and outlook for its first fiscal quarter ending January 2, 2027.
